lead_raw_text:
The structure of ErAlSi₂ crystallizes in the trigonal space group P3m1 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing four atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al and one Si orbit as tetrahedrally coordinated by four Si neighbors, while Er is surrounded by twelve Si neighbors and another Si orbit has nine neighbors. The Al tetrahedra share corners with Er and with Si polyhedra, and Er polyhedra share edges with Al tetrahedra and with Si polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
